verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as bulk editing, importing or deleting subscribers or campaigns, or batch API calls, are a fair axis for an email marketing platform. The evidence pack never documents any of these. The 'put repetitive tasks on autopilot' claim describes automation workflows, an adjacent feature, not bulk multi-item operations, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
